title: President Donald Trump On Charlottesville: You Had Very Fine People, On Both Sides | CNBC
summary: A CNBC clip of President Trump's August 2017 press briefing at Trump Tower in which he answers questions about the Charlottesville rally and says there were 'very fine people on both sides'. It is the unedited footage of the remarks.
why: Commenters link it as the full primary source so people can judge for themselves how the remarks were quoted and portrayed in media.
